stage1_replication_criterion.rule: Stage 1 may proceed to independent MATLAB/Simulink validation only if the immutable policy bundle passes all nominal/high overall and boundary false-safe confidence limits, binary accuracy/precision/recall limits, population-degradation checks, integrity checks, and probe safety checks. Secondary CAUTION/UNSAFE confusion does not veto progression unless it creates a SAFE prediction for a truly NON-SAFE target.
